newsitem.title: MONACO: Merger creates fifth largest UK law firm.
newsitem.headline: Merger creates fifth largest UK law firm.

text.p: Leading London law firms Dibb Lupton Broomhead and Alsop Wilkinson said on Monday that they are to merge on October 1 in a move that will create the fifth largest law firm the UK.

The new company will be known as Dibb Lupton Alsop and will concentrate largely on the provision of legal services to the insurance and reinsurance markets, they said at a Monte Carlo insurance meeting.

Dibb Lupton Broomhead reinsurance partner Susan Dingwall said, "Dibb Lupton Alsop will benefit from the strong reputation which both firms have enjoyed in the London market. At the same time the merger will enable us to further develop complimentary practice areas."
-- Gordon Mackenzie, Reuters Insurance News +377 93 50 65 00 ext 88031
